WinUI 2 (Microsoft.UI.Xaml 2.x), vendored for NovaOS
====================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml (MIT, LICENSE),
branch winui2/main, commit ac1341314cc895c23cee47e941ca6ad387ef9907
(2024-09-12).  WinUI 2 is the controls library UWP apps ship (the
Microsoft.UI.Xaml NuGet package and framework package), written in
C++/WinRT over the system's Windows.UI.Xaml.  userland/microsoft_ui_xaml
builds it as Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll (roadmap step 32.5;
docs/design/windows-ui-xaml.md).

Kept so far: idl/ (Microsoft.UI.Xaml.idl, which imports every feature's
IDL, and DPCodeGenAttributes.idl), dev/dll (the DLL's own sources, its
precompiled header, its .def and the T4 templates xamlmeta.py ports),
dev/inc (the shared headers, with gsl), dev/Generated (the properties files
Microsoft's code generator wrote, for the features kept), and, of each
feature the DLL builds, its sources, headers, IDL and .vcxitems: TestHooks,
Common, Telemetry, ResourceHelper, Collections, Effects,
Materials/{Acrylic,Reveal,Backdrop}, Lights, ImageIcon, IconSource,
AnimatedVisualPlayer, AnimatedIcon (with AnimatedVisuals), SplitButton,
DropDownButton, InfoBadge, ProgressBar, ProgressRing (with
AnimatedVisuals), SwipeControl, Repeater, NavigationView and
RadioButtons; and TabView/TabViewTrace.h (TestHooks
includes it).  The XAML pages (.xaml) each of those .vcxitems lists, with
CommonStyles (its .vcxitems and pages: WinUI 2's styles of the system
controls), dev/dll/DensityStyles/Compact.xaml and dev/dll/Microsoft.UI.Xaml.vcxproj
(whose import order orders the pages when they are merged:
userland/microsoft_ui_xaml/mergexaml.py).  Left out: the tests, the
samples, and the other MSBuild projects.
Files keep their CRLF line ends and byte-order marks.

Changed for clang (marked here, the files otherwise as upstream):
  dev/Collections/Vector.h      ##Options## and Options##:: pasting (which
                                only MSVC's preprocessor accepts) written
                                Options and Options::; "typename" left off
                                VectorInnerType and T, which are not
                                qualified names
  dev/Collections/Vector.h, VectorIterator.h, HashMap.h
                                reference_tracker_implements_t<X>::type
                                named as the member template it is
                                (::template type)
  dev/Materials/Acrylic/AcrylicBrush.cpp
                                winrt::TimeSpan::duration(...) (MSVC
                                takes the constructor name as the type)
                                written winrt::TimeSpan(...)
  dev/Repeater/SelectedItems.h, VirtualLayoutContextAdapter.h
                                reference_tracker_implements_t<X>::type
                                named as a member template (::template type)
  dev/NavigationView/SplitDataSourceBase.h
                                "typename" left off T, SplitVectorID and
                                AttachedDataType, which are not qualified
                                names
  dev/NavigationView/NavigationView.cpp
                                [[gsl::suppress(con.4)]] written with the
                                string argument clang wants
The build also copies dev/Generated with [[gsl::suppress(con)]] written
with the string argument clang wants (userland/microsoft_ui_xaml/build.py).

To add a feature: copy its folder's .cpp, .h, .idl, .xaml pages and .vcxitems
(and its dev/Generated files) from the same commit, add its .vcxitems to FEATURES
in userland/microsoft_ui_xaml/build.py, and list it above.
